parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The domain name. Call the [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains) operation to obtain the domain name.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values are:

- **zh**: Chinese. This is the default value.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from **1**. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is **100**. The default value is **20**.

parameters.name: UserClientIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the client.
